issues.title: Robots.txt format error / unexpected directive
issues.root_cause: Cloudflare Edge AI Scrape Shield automatically injected 'Content-Signal: search=yes,ai-train=no,use=reference' header and bot-specific directive fragments into edge responses. Additionally, bot-specific blocks in robots.txt could inadvertently conflict with global disallow directives.
issues.remediation_strategy: Normalized repository robots.txt to strictly adhere to RFC 9309 with a single User-agent: * block disallowing /api/, /admin, /test/, and pointing to canonical https://www.livworthy.com/sitemap.xml. Documented edge headers as intentional Cloudflare Edge settings.

issues.title: Missing sitemap declaration in robots.txt / Sitemap index format
issues.reproduction_result: Not Reproducible / Confirmed in early crawl
issues.root_cause: Robots.txt was missing absolute HTTPS canonical sitemap index directive in initial deploy before static SEO pipeline execution.
issues.remediation_strategy: Embedded 'Sitemap: https://www.livworthy.com/sitemap.xml' permanently in public/robots.txt and dist/robots.txt generator, linking to 17 segmented sitemaps indexing 1,924 valid pages.
issues.verification_method: curl -s https://www.livworthy.com/robots.txt | grep Sitemap && test/seo/canonical-redirect-regression.test.ts Test B

issues.title: sitemap-reports.xml crawl failure (HTTP 404/500)
issues.root_cause: Transient crawler timeout or temporary build sync race condition during previous deployment. Verified live endpoint returns HTTP 200 with application/xml in <100ms.
issues.remediation_strategy: Verified sitemap-reports.xml is generated statically in scripts/generate-seo.ts, deployed as static asset in public/ and dist/, and served directly by Vercel static router with 200 OK.

issues.title: Structured data schema warnings (SoftwareApplication without ratings/reviews)
issues.root_cause: Pages declared schema type 'SoftwareApplication' without aggregateRating or review fields, triggering Semrush and Google Search Console non-critical markup warnings.
issues.remediation_strategy: Updated schema type to '@type': 'WebApplication' with operatingSystem: 'Any', applicationCategory: 'FinanceApplication', and explicit featureList. Refused to fabricate synthetic user reviews or ratings in strict accordance with Google Quality Rater & Review guidelines.
issues.verification_method: npx tsx scripts/generate-seo.ts && Google Rich Results test / schema inspection

issues.title: Hreflang conflicts & missing self-referencing hreflang tags
issues.root_cause: Prerenderer generated alternate hreflang tags for English tool roots (/salary-after-tax) pointing to language roots (/es, /fr) instead of localized tool subpaths (/es/salary-after-tax, /fr/salary-after-tax), resulting in missing self-referencing hreflang tags and broken reciprocal link clusters.
issues.remediation_strategy: Refactored hreflang generator in scripts/generate-seo.ts. Every localized route and root tool route now generates an exact self-referencing hreflang, reciprocal links across all 10 LONG_FORM_LOCALES, and an x-default link pointing to the primary English route.

issues.title: Duplicate content / duplicate NYC salary guide URL
issues.root_cause: Legacy build alias duplicated /guides/nyc-100k at /guides/100k-salary-new-york, creating two competing indexable URLs with identical text and titles.
issues.remediation_strategy: Removed static prerendering of /guides/100k-salary-new-york. Established canonical 308 (server.ts) and 301 (vercel.json) permanent redirects from /guides/100k-salary-new-york to https://www.livworthy.com/guides/nyc-100k. Updated all internal links and test assertions.

issues.title: Title tag length exceeds 70 characters
issues.root_cause: Verbose metadata templates included redundant platform brand suffixes and repetitive descriptor keywords, causing titles to reach 75-88 characters.
issues.remediation_strategy: Optimized metadata titles across directories and bilateral comparisons: /countries (47 chars), /cities (47 chars), /guides (38 chars), /compare (42 chars), bilateral comparisons ('${cityA.name} vs ${cityB.name}: Salary & Living Costs | LivWorthy' <= 65 chars).

issues.title: Thin content / low word count (< 200 words)
issues.root_cause: Programmatically generated country, city, tool landing, and legal/institutional pages contained minimalist copy focusing primarily on dynamic calculator mounting hooks.
issues.remediation_strategy: Enriched prerendered HTML with comprehensive editorial sections (>300 words each): statutory tax schedules, social insurance rules, median take-home pay, housing cost benchmarks, calculation methodology, and data provenance citations.
issues.verification_method: scripts/generate-seo.ts build output & word count inspection across dist/*.html

issues.title: Broken external links / timeouts
issues.root_cause: Government tax authorities and statistical portals migrated legacy document URLs or enforced strict Akamai anti-bot challenges on automated crawler user-agents.
issues.remediation_strategy: Audited all 89 citations in src/data/evidence-registry.ts via scripts/test-citation-health.ts. Updated 7 outdated URLs to permanent canonical resource endpoints. 82 citations returned HTTP 200 OK directly, 2 bot-protected government portals confirmed accessible in browser, 5 regional tax portals verified active.

issues.title: Uncontrolled query parameter indexing risks (/?city=...&tab=...)
issues.root_cause: Legacy footer and comparison cards used client-side state query parameters rather than clean canonical directory and tool routes.
issues.remediation_strategy: Purged all internal query-parameter navigation links in prerendered HTML templates. Replaced with clean canonical paths (/cities/nyc, /salary-after-tax, /compare/new-york-vs-london). Enforced Disallow: /api/, /admin, /test/ in robots.txt.
issues.verification_method: grep_search for query links across dist/*.html && test/seo/canonical-redirect-regression.test.ts
